title: Dao Xuan against the Beast Deity; Lu Xueqi shields Gui Li
summary: Gui Li reaches Tongtian Peak, the heart of the Sword Formation that Wan Jianyi told him about. Dao Xuan, with the Tianji Seal open, fights the Beast Deity at the formation's full power, and the Beast Deity says he has finally found an opponent worth fighting. In the Yuqing Hall it is explained that the seal's power is endless but it eats the wielder's life. Dao Xuan wounds the Beast Deity badly and seals the sword's evil aura with his own sword intent, but his life energy runs out and the Beast Deity claims victory. Gui Li puts his grudge with Dao Xuan aside and attacks the Beast Deity, who turns to destroy the Zhu Xian Sword. When Qingyun disciples turn on Gui Li, Lu Xueqi stands in their way and tells him to leave and never come back, and a senior asks whether she means to betray the sect. Qingyun people head into the Huanyue forbidden ground to find the ancient sword, and Great Bamboo Peak's people catch up with Gui Li and recognise him as their seventh disciple.
events: Gui Li arrives at Tongtian Peak, the heart of the formation

Qingyun people enter the Huanyue forbidden ground to find the sword; Great Bamboo Peak finds their seventh disciple
cultivation: The Beast Deity says Dao Xuan seems to have the best cultivation foundation in the world.
